windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the black stove knob.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the stove burner.
Approach the stove knob from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the black knob on the stove by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Grasp the black knob on the stove burner by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Hold the gripper steady above the stove burner to align with the control knob.
Hold the closed gripper on the stove burner to turn it on.
Hold the closed gripper on the stove burner to turn it on.
